verdict.rationale: cubic documents a one-click "Fix with cubic" action on review findings that generates a fix and pushes it to the PR branch, so the one-click apply outcome is delivered. However, nothing shows review comments containing an inline suggested diff the developer can preview and commit, like GitHub suggestion blocks; the fix is produced afterward by a background coding agent. Missing for 10: evidence of inline committable suggestion diffs in review comments, preview of the proposed change before applying, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click

citations.quote: When the AI spots a problem, you can click the **Fix with cubic** button
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
